check_distributed_mode: check if the current process is running in distributed mode using is_distributed
gather_data_from_workers: gather arbitrary picklable data from all distributed workers into a single list using all_gather_list
sync_model_parameters: sync all model parameters across distributed workers so every worker has identical weights using sync_parameters
initialize_distributed_context: initialize a distributed training context with GPU assignment and process group setup using distributed_context
find_available_port: find a free local port number to bind a new TCP socket using find_free_port
